# @desolint/cache

> 标签: cache, ioredis, redis

## 简介

Generic, fail-safe Redis cache wrapper (get/set/del/clear/has/getOrSet). No root export — import only what you need: @desolint/cache/config, /services.

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/desolint/package-cache#readme
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/desolint/package-cache.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@desolint/cache
